manifest.purpose: Authenticate both complete source-bound baselines, freeze the two final SELECT clause controls on unchanged and rejected proposal sources, then verify the exact corrected catalog/CTE/output-alias source and full required gates.

contracts.upstream_sqlc_boundary: The exact native-valid/direct-allow case must retain the observed relation b refusal, no plugin request and no generated files. The other36 actual SQLc predictions remain strict.
contracts.catalog_diagnostics: Candidate version refusals require the resolved catalog spelling; invalid configuration requires the frozen missing or ambiguous-column diagnostic. Baseline option-spelling diagnostics are not reused as candidate expectations.
contracts.request_identity: All 48 captured catalog hashes/byte lengths, complete query metadata, processed SQL text/hashes and original configuration must equal authenticated or same-job unchanged-source records. Compare all 49 original native vectors and all 48 processed vectors exactly.
contracts.nested_race: Two distinct complete generated modules must execute the actual immutable compiler with ['test','-race','-count=1','-v','.']; inspect both real outer launcher records.
contracts.frozen_test_bytes: All nine original compiled test/data files remain byte-identical. Two separate test/data paths add the frozen IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM controls; the same complete 11-file test set is used before and after the production repair.
gates: authenticate baseline ZIP and 136 complete command logs
authenticate alias diagnostic ZIP and 73 complete command logs
two original native clause controls, compiled unchanged/proposed expected RED, four strict SQLc/native handoffs, exact source restoration
11 catalog, 26 CTE, 10 projection and 2 clause named PASS
49 strict real SQLc outcomes with native handoff comparison
60 permanent pipeline and 8 direct runtime cases with actual nested race invocation

clause_observation.frozen_source_order: Native originals first, then compiled unchanged source and compiled frozen rejected proposal; verify exact source snapshots and restore original source before corrected candidate application.

source_review.scope: Corrected SELECT output-alias classification plus unchanged reviewed catalog and CTE-header fixes. Independent source review pending; no native corrected-source result claimed.

preserved_failed_baselines.diagnostic: complexity::cognitive_overflow: function versionCatalogRequest is too complex: nesting depth 4 exceeds 3, cognitive score 18 exceeds 15

manifest.credential_boundary: SPIRA_ARTIFACT_TOKEN is popped as the first statement of main before any compiler, PostgreSQL, SQLc or test child. It is passed explicitly only to immutable artifact authentication. The token-bearing shell invokes no compiler command.
